blocks.orig: The Kankari Lodge is ideally situated between Lake Manyara National Park and the entrance to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, in the picturesque Ngorongoro Highlands. The intimate lodge boasts 4 comfortable tents and 8 double rooms, divided among 4 cottages lined up in a neatly maintained garden. All rooms and tents are ensuite and fitted with double or twin beds, a private terrace, a dressing area and a couch. The rooms also boast a fireplace, set in a welcoming wooden decor, mixing bright and natural colours. Enjoy your meals in the cosy bar and dining room that overlooks the swimming pool. In the evening, you can gather around the fire and stargaze under the beautiful African sky.
blocks.html: In the picturesque Ngorongoro Highlands, the Kankari Lodge has an ideal position between Lake Manyara National Park and the gate of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. This intimate lodge has 4 comfortable tents and 8 double rooms, spread over 4 cottages set in a row in a well-kept garden. Every room and tent is ensuite and comes with double or twin beds, a private terrace, a dressing area and a couch. The rooms also have a fireplace, in an inviting wooden interior that combines bright and natural colours. Have your meals in the cosy bar and dining room looking out over the swimming pool. In the evening you can sit around the fire and look at the stars beneath the beautiful African sky.
